verdict.rationale: Supabase publishes a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (openapi.json returns HTTP 200) and documents a JavaScript auth-api reference, so programmatic access exists. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows that every dashboard action has an API equivalent. The docs point to the dashboard 'JWT expiry limit' field for one setting without naming an API path for it. missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, documented API coverage of admin and dashboard settings (e.g. JWT expiry, provider configuration), independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: their access token JWT is automatically managed and sent for you with every API call
